description.en: The ID of the edge transcoding job.

descriptions.zh:
- 本接口用于更新边缘转码任务。

- 用户需要具有访问边缘转码服务的权限，且转码任务处于未启动状态，才能正常调用本接口。
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为6000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- This operation updates an edge transcoding job.

- To call this operation, you must have permissions to access the edge transcoding service. The transcoding job must not have been started.

## QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 6,000 calls per minute per user. If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled. This may impact your business. Plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live update-edge-transcode-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id 0000003b-4d18-395c-8106-ff21a6000000 --job-id 000020b48fb04483915d4f2cd8ac0000 --name task1 --template-id 000096e8864746a0b6f30000 --stream-input rtmp://mydomain/app/stream1 --stream-output rtmp://testdomain/app/stream2 --region cn-hangzhou
